exposure: Prenatal heparin-binding epidermal growth factor (HB-EGF) administration
outcome: Alveolar morphometry (mean alveolar area, alveolar wall area)
cohort: The study participants were pregnant mice and their pups exposed to a necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) model.
finding: Prenatal HB-EGF administration preserved lung morphometry (indicated by increased mean alveolar area and decreased alveolar wall area) and decreased TLR-4-expressing cells in a murine model of NEC-induced lung injury.
followup_time: Pups were sacrificed on signs of NEC
